decisionItems.proposal: organisation_id root; nullable workspace_id for organisation-wide records; workspace-safe composite reference; no synthetic workspace
decisionItems.rationale: Approved: organisation_id is the tenant root; workspace scope is explicit and nullable; composite references prevent cross-organisation workspace links; no synthetic workspace is introduced.

decisionItems.proposal: identity.users attribution plus organisation membership composite references; optional workspace_membership_id for workspace-scoped thread participation; active status remains action-time policy
decisionItems.rationale: Approved: Identity owns user identity; Organisation owns membership; workspace membership is an optional scoped reference. Foreign keys establish existence only; activity and authorization remain runtime policy.

decisionItems.proposal: generated UUID keys, explicit FK/relation pairs, tenant-safe unique keys, direct-message normalized pair checks, and listed indexes
decisionItems.rationale: Approved: keys, explicit FK/relation pairs, tenant-scoped uniqueness, direct-message normalization, and declared indexes are recorded as MAATAA design decisions. Physical dialect validation remains separate.

decisionItems.proposal: separate semantic notification from delivery attempts; unread/read/dismissed state with read/dismiss timestamps
decisionItems.rationale: Approved: notification state represents in-product user state; delivery attempts are separate records. This intentionally revises the retained unreviewed notifications proposal.

decisionItems.proposal: recipient policy keyed per organisation, user, notification type, and channel; in-app/email/push; no provider secrets
decisionItems.rationale: Approved: preferences are per organisation/user/type/channel, with in-app/email/push values and no provider secrets or workspace override in v1.

decisionItems.proposal: queued/sending/sent/delivered and failed/suppressed transitions; retries insert a new attempt; provider metadata stays with each attempt
decisionItems.rationale: Approved: each delivery row is an append-oriented attempt, retries create new rows, and provider metadata belongs to attempts. Provider integration and operational behavior remain unselected.

decisionItems.proposal: organisation/workspace threads; members carry lifecycle/read position; messages carry author/content/order/state; membership authorization remains policy
decisionItems.rationale: Approved: threads, members, and messages use explicit tenant/workspace references and lifecycle fields. Membership authorization and cross-row membership consistency still need application-policy enforcement.

decisionItems.proposal: opaque storage_ref and metadata only; no binary payload or selected provider; retention follows parent message
decisionItems.rationale: Approved: attachments store opaque storage references and metadata only; the provider is unspecified and payload bytes remain outside the relational row.

decisionItems.proposal: workspace-scoped pair of workspace-membership IDs; canonical ascending check plus unique key; no caller-only sorting
decisionItems.rationale: Approved: direct-message pair normalization is enforced by declared database checks and uniqueness, scoped to one workspace. The target dialect must prove the checks and composite references.

decisionItems.proposal: organisation or workspace audience; draft/scheduled/published/expired/retired; no opaque audience blob; acknowledgements excluded pending table decision
decisionItems.rationale: Approved: announcement audience is organisation-wide or one workspace, represented relationally; lifecycle transitions are explicit; recipient acknowledgement/snapshot storage is excluded pending a catalog decision.

decisionItems.proposal: nine MAATAA retention windows proposed; hold overrides ordinary deletion; legal/compliance approval remains required
decisionItems.rationale: Approved as proposed MAATAA product defaults only. The nine durations and hold override are not legal or statutory determinations; legal/compliance approval remains a mandatory later gate.

decisionItems.proposal: retained as unreviewed evidence; proposed state and tenant keys revise it; reviewer must accept/revise/reject the differences
decisionItems.rationale: Approved: the earlier notifications artifact remains unreviewed historical evidence and is not canonical authority; this source records the reviewed replacement semantics without claiming external lineage.

approvalRecord.basis: Recorded under the user’s explicit instruction; thelinep is the assigned reviewer for all roles.
approvalRecord.scope: MAATAA-authored Communications design semantics for source admission only.

note: All twelve group decisions are accepted as MAATAA-authored design semantics by assigned reviewer thelinep, recorded under explicit user instruction. COMM-11 accepts only proposed product defaults and hold precedence; legal/compliance approval remains mandatory. This is a review record, not a cryptographic signature. Approval does not promote canonical table contracts or grant schema, compiler, migration, or production readiness.
